arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ.
transliteration: Thahabath-thama'u wabtallatil-'urooqu, wa thabatal-ajru in shaa'allaah.
translation: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي.
transliteration: Allahumma innee as'aluka birahmatikal-latee wasi'at kulla shay'in an taghfira lee.
translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, that You forgive me.
reference: Ibn Majah 1/557, from a supplication of Abdullah bin 'Amr
